description: This Java class implements data access object (DAO) methods for handling product reviews within an e-commerce system. It provides functions to retrieve reviews by customer, product, product and customer IDs, and with language filtering, using QueryDSL for building JPQL queries. The class extends a generic DAO implementation and interacts with JPA entity models representing reviews, products, customers, and related entities.
